bio: Tessa is FinMark Trust’s Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Intern. She has a passion for uplifting marginalised communities and driving meaningful transformation. Tessa has held a key role in the Youth Programmes, South African Institute of International Affairs (Youth@SAIIA), where she served as the National Focal Points Person for the Youth Policy Committee. She is a dedicated advocate for social change and youth empowerment. Tessa is currently pursuing a master’s in development studies at the University of Johannesburg, while also a candidate in the ‘Rule of Law and Equal Access to Welfare’ programme at the Just Society, University of Southern Denmark. She has also been selected as a candidate in the South African Monitoring and Evaluation Association’s Emerging Evaluators programme.
name: Tessa Klaas
